messages:
erin: quick follow-up on the shard-pool sketch i shared — want alignment on operator boundaries before we freeze the API

devon: main worry: how do we keep a low p99 for the fast path without starving steady tenants?

erin: proposal = two logical lanes per pool: fast-path (prewarmed, thin packing) and steady-path (dense packing, tolerant of cold starts)

kai: promotions/demotions could thrash. what's the stabilization?
erin: we require sustained demand: sustain_window_s (config). trigger when fast_path_util > 0.8 for sustain_window_s, move a small chunk, add cooldown
tessa: specify chunk. defaults?
erin: default: min(10% of pool, 2 gpus). tenants with SLA can set overrides (capped by contract)
devon: billing concerns — who pays when we carve GPUs for fast-path?
erin: two-layer accounting: baseline reservation billed as usual; transient fast-path use logged to a shared burst ledger with tenant, gpus, start/end, preemptible flag

kai: eviction ordering must be explicit. draft priority: pinned -> gold SLA -> silver SLA -> burst-credit -> preemptible
tessa: fairness: frequent small bursters could hog the burst pool
erin: add burst_score with exponential decay (1h half-life). admission prefers tenants with lower recent share
devon: controller topology? central reconciler or operator-per-shard?
erin: operator-per-shard for local decisions + global reconciler (leader-elected) to enforce pool caps and coordinate moves
kai: KV cache warmup risk when promoting running VMs
erin: operator will prefer cold allocations first. live demote only for low-util instances with KV sync capability; otherwise drain steady nodes gradually
orch-bot: deploy-planner: creating canary plan template for us-west-2
tessa: rollout and metrics?
erin: canary us-west-2, 10% pools, 48h. metrics: fast_path_util, p99_by_SLA, promotion_count, eviction_events, burst_ledger_debits
devon: ledger retention for disputes?
erin: default 180d, compress older entries after 30d to daily aggregates
kai: test plan: unit tests for admission math, k8s-integration for operator behavior, chaos tests for leader failover and promotion under churn
erin: i'll author the follow-up RFC tonight with config schema, rollout checklist, and dashboard wireframe
tessa: tiny nit: rename promotion_window_s -> sustain_window_s to clarify intent
erin: done in draft. syncing tomorrow 10am PT to finalize rollout thresholds
erin: thanks all :thumbsup:
